integrity.proof_type: analytic, with supplementary standalone exact-rational and numerical reproduction

limitations: Applies only to positive direction-constant conductances on the infinite honeycomb and its square-periodic quotients.
Does not claim novelty of the general resolvent nonnegativity criterion or of existing honeycomb walk generating functions.
A specialist source could contain an equivalent implication; publication priority is not certified.
title: Sharp anisotropy and periodic-size laws for Crank–Nicolson positivity on honeycomb diffusion graphs
